name: The Last Empire
tagline: Nobility, thievery, and intrigue in a dying empire.

attributes.name: Body
attributes.description: Raw strength, toughness, and physical capability.

skills.name: Hand-to-Hand
skills.description: Unarmed fighting: fists, grapples, and dirty tricks.

skills.name: Melee Weapons
skills.description: Blades, clubs, and anything else swung in anger.

skills.name: Blocking
skills.description: Turning blows aside with shield, weapon, or forearm.

skills.name: Dodging
skills.description: Not being where the attack lands.

skills.name: Ranged Weapons
skills.description: Bows, crossbows, and thrown blades.

skills.name: Sneaking
skills.description: Moving unseen and unheard.

skills.name: Thievery
skills.description: Picking locks, lifting purses, palming valuables.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Winning someone over with honest argument.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: Getting your way through fear.

skills.name: Charm
skills.description: Being liked, quickly and deliberately.

skills.name: Etiquette
skills.description: The rituals and manners of noble society.

skills.name: Dance
skills.description: Grace at balls and festivals — where deals are made.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Knowing the gutters: fences, gangs, and rumors below.

skills.name: Politics
skills.description: Factions, favors, and the machinery of power.

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Lying convincingly, in word and in bearing.

skills.name: Gossip
skills.description: Hearing secrets first and planting your own.

skills.name: Research
skills.description: Digging truth out of archives and libraries.

skills.name: History
skills.description: The rise and rot of the Empire and its houses.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Magic, myth, and the things scholars whisper about.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Reading scenes, connecting clues, finding what's hidden.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Treating wounds, poisons, and fevers.

abilities.name: Bodymancy
abilities.description: Magic of flesh: mending, hardening, and reshaping the body.

abilities.name: Emomancy
abilities.description: Magic of emotion: stoking fear, calm, love, and rage.

abilities.name: Ferromancy
abilities.description: Magic of iron and steel: shaping and commanding metal.

abilities.name: Magnetomancy
abilities.description: Magic of attraction and repulsion: pushing and pulling the world.

abilities.name: Sensomancy
abilities.description: Magic of the senses: sharpening, dulling, and deceiving them.

abilities.name: Manamancy
abilities.description: Magic of magic itself: sensing, weaving, and unraveling spells.

backgrounds.name: Fallen Noble
backgrounds.description: Your house lost everything but its manners. You keep the manners.

backgrounds.name: Street Rat
backgrounds.description: The gutters raised you hard and quick.

backgrounds.name: Slave Prodigy
backgrounds.description: Born with a gift your masters tried to own.

itemTemplates.name: Court Attire
itemTemplates.description: Fine enough to pass at a minor ball.

itemTemplates.name: Rope & Grapnel
itemTemplates.description: Fifty feet of silk rope with a padded hook.

itemTemplates.name: Vial of Poison
itemTemplates.description: Slow, quiet, and hard to trace.
